description: List recent cold/first-contact inbound (message.received) for an agent — senders that are NOT replying to one of your sends — together with mail that failed authentication (message.received.unauthenticated: its From domain's DMARC policy is quarantine or reject, and no DKIM signature aligned with that domain verifies), newest first. name: mails_list_messages
title: List first-contact mail
